title: Project PIAF: Building a Native French Question-Answering Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing Question Answering model performance using machine-translated English datasets (SQuAD-Fr) versus natively collected French datasets (PIAFv1.0, FQUAD) to demonstrate the limitations of English-centric transfer learning and the necessity for native language resources.

Evaluating model generalization across different datasets to determine if models overfit to the writing styles of a small group of annotators, and mitigating this by measuring performance when trained on data from a large, diverse pool of volunteer contributors.
